The cashier looked quieter than usual that evening. Tom's dream job is to be a cook. On Saturday evenings, Tom reviews the notes from class. Also, he passed his driving licence test.

The supermarket has become an important part of daily life. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Nina always says that small steps matter more than big plans. In fact, the curio cabinet rattles in wind.
There are always more possibilities than we expect. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. The experience taught Tom more than any book could. Also, the sky became dark before the storm.

People around Tom often share different ideas about the cashier. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Tom is saving money to buy a ticket to Rome. A pencil skirt strides best in flats.
Tom has practiced basketball for three years and won a prize last term. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Tom wrote down every idea in a small notebook.
